date-time-picker.name: DateTimePicker
date-time-picker.description:
One picker for dates, times, both together, and ranges, the way Apple's
compact DatePicker works: a chip for the date, a chip for the time, each
opening its own panel. The date panel is a calendar whose month title opens
month and year wheels, so a far date is one flick and not a hundred taps.
The time panel is hour, minute and period wheels. Values are plain strings
(`YYYY-MM-DD`, `HH:MM`, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM`) or a `{ from, to }` range, so
they go straight to a form or an API.

props.description: Minutes offered in the time columns. Default 5.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the slider is read-only

props.name: step
props.description: The step value of the slider

props.name: thumbAlignment
props.description:
The alignment of the slider thumb relative to the track
- `center`: the thumb will extend beyond the bounds of the slider track.
- `contain`: the thumb will be contained within the bounds of the track.

props.name: thumbCollisionBehavior
props.description:
Controls how thumbs behave when they collide during pointer interactions.
- `none` (default): Thumbs cannot move past each other; excess movement is ignored.
- `push`: Thumbs push each other without restoring their previous positions when dragged back.
- `swap`: Thumbs swap places when dragged past each other.

props.name: thumbSize
props.description: The slider thumbs dimensions

spinner.name: Spinner
spinner.description: An indeterminate activity indicator. Colour follows the text colour.

switch.name: Switch
switch.description: An on or off switch. Renders a native hidden checkbox with `role="switch"`.

props.name: checked
props.description: The controlled checked state of the switch

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description:
The initial checked state of the switch when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the checked state of the switch.

props.name: dir
props.description: The document's text/writing direction.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the switch is disabled.

props.name: form
props.description: The id of the form that the switch belongs to

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: invalid
props.description: If `true`, the switch is marked as invalid.

props.name: label
props.description: Specifies the localized strings that identifies the accessibility elements and their states

props.name: name
props.description:
The name of the input field in a switch
(Useful for form submission).

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the switch is read-only

props.name: required
props.description: If `true`, the switch input is marked as required,

props.name: size
props.description: Track height, width and thumb.

props.name: tone
props.description: The colour of the switched on track. `accent` follows the chosen accent.

props.name: value
props.description: The value of switch input. Useful for form submission.

props.name: variant
props.description: `liquid` lets a second drop of glass chase the thumb through a goo filter, so it stretches as it travels.

tab-bar.name: TabBar
tab-bar.description: The bottom tab bar: a floating glass capsule of destinations, with one lens that glides to the chosen one.

props.name: action
props.description:
A separate round button beside the capsule, the iOS 26 "four and one"
layout: four destinations and a search or compose action of their own.

props.name: autoMinimize
props.description:
Minimizes by itself while the person scrolls down through content and
restores on scroll up, at the top, or when the bar is tapped.

props.name: minimized
props.description: Shrinks to icons only, like iOS 26 while you scroll down. Leave undefined to let `autoMinimize` decide.

props.name: size
props.description: Item size, from the symbol to the label.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible name. Always kept for assistive technology, even when minimized.

props.name: active
props.description: The current destination.

tab-bar.name: TabBarAction
tab-bar.description: The round button beside the capsule, for the one action that is not a destination, usually search.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the button for assistive technology.

props.name: activationMode
props.description:
The activation mode of the tabs. Can be `manual` or `automatic`
- `manual`: Tabs are activated when clicked or press `enter` key.
- `automatic`: Tabs are activated when receiving focus

props.name: composite
props.description: Whether the tab is composite

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The initial selected tab value when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the selected tab value.

props.name: deselectable
props.description: Whether the active tab can be deselected when clicking on it.

props.name: dir
props.description: The document's text/writing direction.

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: Whether the keyboard navigation will loop from last tab to first, and vice versa.

props.name: navigate
props.description:
Function to navigate to the selected tab when clicking on it.
Useful if tab triggers are anchor elements.

props.name: onFocusChange
props.description: Callback to be called when the focused tab changes

props.name: orientation
props.description:
The orientation of the tabs. Can be `horizontal` or `vertical`
- `horizontal`: only left and right arrow key navigation will work.
- `vertical`: only up and down arrow key navigation will work.

props.name: tone
props.description: The theme role that colors the selection.

props.name: translations
props.description: Specifies the localized strings that identifies the accessibility elements and their states

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled selected tab value

props.name: variant
props.description: The look of the tab strip.

textarea.name: Textarea
textarea.description:
A multi line field that grows with its content. It can float its label like
`Input` and count characters against `maxLength`. The resize grip is gone:
the field sizes itself.

props.name: label
props.description: The floating label.

props.name: showCount
props.description: Shows `count / maxLength` under the field. Needs `maxLength`.

props.name: size
props.description: Minimum height and text, from the shared control scale.

props.name: variant
props.description: `floating` draws one whole outline whose top line parts under the label. Needs `label`.

toast.name: Toaster
toast.description:
Toasts drop from the top centre like an island: a small pill carrying the
icon, out of which the message flows. Both shapes sit under an SVG "goo"
filter, so where they meet looks liquid while they grow, morph between
states and shrink away. Text is drawn above the filter to stay crisp.

toggle-group.name: ToggleGroup
toggle-group.description: A row of toggles. `multiple` allows several on at once; otherwise it behaves like a segmented control.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The initial selected value of the toggle group when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the selected value of the toggle group.

props.name: deselectable
props.description:
Whether the toggle group allows empty selection.
**Note:** This is ignored if `multiple` is `true`.

props.name: dir
props.description: The document's text/writing direction.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the toggle is disabled.

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: Whether to loop focus inside the toggle group.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Whether to allow multiple toggles to be selected.

props.name: orientation
props.description: The orientation of the toggle group.

props.name: rovingFocus
props.description: Whether to use roving tab index to manage focus.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled selected value of the toggle group.

trace.name: Trace
trace.description: A timeline of steps: reasoning, tool calls, sources. Each step can fold open its detail.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Opens the detail by default.

props.name: meta
props.description: A short note beside the title, such as a duration.

props.name: status
props.description: The state of this step.

tooltip.name: Tooltip
tooltip.description:
Opens on hover and keyboard focus only, never on touch. After one tip opens,
its neighbours open without the delay (Zag shares that warm-up window).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Custom label for the tooltip.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: The close delay of the tooltip.

props.name: closeOnClick
props.description: Whether the tooltip should close on click

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: Whether to close the tooltip when the Escape key is pressed.

props.name: closeOnPointerDown
props.description: Whether to close the tooltip on pointerdown.

props.name: closeOnScroll
props.description: Whether the tooltip should close on scroll

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description:
The initial open state of the tooltip when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the open state of the tooltip.

props.name: defaultTriggerValue
props.description:
The initial trigger value when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the trigger value.

props.name: dir
props.description: The document's text/writing direction.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the tooltip is disabled

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: interactive
props.description:
Whether the tooltip's content is interactive.
In this mode, the tooltip will remain open when user hovers over the content.

props.name: offset
props.description: Gap between trigger and tip, in pixels. Defaults to 6.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Function called when the tooltip is opened.

props.name: onTriggerValueChange
props.description: Function called when the trigger value changes.

props.name: open
props.description: The controlled open state of the tooltip

props.name: openDelay
props.description: The open delay of the tooltip.

props.name: placement
props.description: Where the tip sits against its trigger. Defaults to `top`.

props.name: triggerValue
props.description: The controlled trigger value

aspect-ratio.name: AspectRatio
aspect-ratio.description: A crop frame: size its geometry, while images cover without distortion.

props.name: ratio
props.description: Width divided by height.

code-block.name: CodeBlock
code-block.description: Code presentation without shipping a highlighter or formatter to consumers.

props.name: children
props.description: Supply a highlighter's rendered pre/code element; source remains the fallback.

props.name: copyable
props.description: Show a copy button that writes `code`.

props.name: foldAfter
props.description: Start folded, with an Expand code button, when the code has more lines than this.

props.name: header
props.description: Replaces the caption with your own content, such as a tab strip that fills the row's height.

props.name: highlightLines
props.description: 1 based lines to mark with a soft accent band, for the lines a paragraph is about.

props.name: labels
props.type: { copy: string; copied: string; expand: string; collapse: string; }
props.description: Names for the copy button and the fold button, so apps can translate them.

props.name: language
props.description: The language's name, shown beside the caption.

props.name: lineNumbers
props.description: Show a nonselectable line gutter.

props.name: size
props.description: Code font size, padding and line gutter scale.

props.name: title
props.description: A caption over the code, such as a file name.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Wrap long lines instead of scrolling sideways.

search-field.name: SearchField
search-field.description:
A search input in a full pill. It is one box whose width is its state:
the lens sits at a fixed inset from the left edge, which at the closed
width happens to centre it in the circle, so opening is the box growing
around a mark that stayed put. Native `type="search"`, so the clear button,
Escape and mobile search keyboards come with it.

props.name: collapsible
props.description:
Rests as a round search button and opens into the field when focused or
when it holds text. Opens to the width of its container, so size a wrapper, not the field.

props.name: size
props.description: Height, icon and text, from the shared control scale.

props.name: variant
props.description: `inset` is a quiet filled field; `floating` is a glass pill that sits above content, like iOS 26's search.

sidebar.name: Sidebar
sidebar.description: The navigation landmark that holds groups of rows. Name it with `aria-label`.

sidebar.name: SidebarGroupLabel
sidebar.description: The group's heading, bold enough to read as a category.

props.name: size
props.description: Matches the rows' size.

sidebar.name: SidebarMenuButton
sidebar.description:
One row. It is an anchor by default; pass `render` for a router link or a
button. The current row carries `aria-current="page"` and the accent.

props.name: badge
props.description: A count or status at the end.

props.name: icon
props.description: A glyph before the label.

props.name: isActive
props.description: The current destination.

props.name: render
props.description: Use your router's link, or a button.

props.name: size
props.description: Row height, text and corners.

stepper.name: Stepper
stepper.description: Discrete increments with disabled boundary actions and a spoken value.

props.name: labels
props.description: Localized accessible names for each action.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Formats the displayed value.

props.name: size
props.description: Label, output and +/- button scale.

props.name: size
props.description: Row height, cell padding and text scale.

ambient.name: Ambient
ambient.description:
Content with its image's colors glowing softly behind it, no card or
edge: a blown-up, blurred copy of the image masked into a circle that
fades into the page, the way Apple lets a photo light its surroundings.

props.name: src
props.description: The image whose colors glow behind the content.

empty.name: Empty
empty.description: A focused empty or unavailable state. Compose it from the parts below.

empty.name: EmptyHeader
empty.description: Groups the media, title and description.

empty.name: EmptyMedia
empty.description: A decorative glyph above the title. Hidden from assistive technology.

empty.name: EmptyContent
empty.description: The next actions, such as buttons.

labeled-content.name: LabeledContent
labeled-content.description:
A row: a label, an optional description, and its control at the trailing
end, as SwiftUI's `LabeledContent`. Wide controls move under the label
when there is no room beside it, rather than squeezing.

props.name: children
props.description: The row's control or value.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible name of the row.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting text directly below the label.

props.name: icon
props.description: A glyph in a soft tile before the label, like a Settings row.

props.name: size
props.description: Row padding density.

props.name: stacked
props.description: Places the control below the label at every width.

props.name: wide
props.description: Places a wide control below its label on phones.

locales.name: Locales
locales.description:
A language list: the current language on a globe trigger, every choice named
in its own language. It sits in the page where you put it and opens like a
Select, so keyboard, typeahead and dismissal come from the same parts.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the control.

props.name: locales
props.description: Language tags to offer, such as `["en", "fr"]`. Each is named in its own language.

props.name: size
props.description: Width of the control.

swatch-picker.name: SwatchPicker
swatch-picker.description: Colour swatches with a check on the chosen one, built on `RadioGroup` so keyboard and form behaviour match.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the group.

props.name: className
props.description: Custom classes for the swatch container.

props.name: size
props.description: Swatch diameter, check icon and caption scale.

swatch-picker.name: AccentPicker
swatch-picker.description:
Passui's seven accents as a swatch picker that retints the app. Choosing
one sets `data-accent` on the root, so buttons, switches, sliders, focus
rings, selection and the window ground all follow, and it survives a reload.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the group.

props.name: names
props.description: Translated names for the accents. Falls back to the token names.

props.name: storageKey
props.description: Remembers the choice in localStorage under this key. Pass `false` to skip.

props.name: target
props.description: The element that carries `data-accent`. Defaults to `<html>`, so every control follows.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled accent. Leave out to let the picker own it.
